# Abdul Rahaman S  
Machine Learning Engineer | Data Scientist  
abdulabd1132000@gmail.com | 8939030306  
[linkedin.com/in/abdul-rahaman-s11](https://linkedin.com/in/abdul-rahaman-s11)  
Chennai | [github.com/11abd](https://github.com/11abd)  

## Summary  
Results-driven Machine Learning Engineer and Data Scientist with extensive experience in developing and deploying AI systems, particularly in the areas of machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP). Proven track record in designing end-to-end ML solutions and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Adept at leveraging advanced techniques such as model fine-tuning and prompt engineering to enhance AI capabilities. Actively transitioning from production support to a dedicated ML engineering role, with a strong focus on building scalable and explainable AI models.

## Skills  
- **Languages:** Python, SQL  
- **Deep Learning & NLP:** TensorFlow, Keras, Transformers, LLM, RAG  
- **MLOps & Deployment:** MLflow, DVC, Docker, GitHub Actions, FastAPI, CI/CD  
- **Cloud & Systems:** AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker), Azure (AZ-900, AZ-104), Git, PostgreSQL  
- **Machine Learning & Data Science:** Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, Model Evaluation, Feature Engineering  

## Projects  
### Fraud Detection System – End-to-End MLOps Project  
- **Technologies:** Python, XGBoost, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, MLflow, Docker, GitHub Actions, SHAP  
- Developed an XGBoost-based fraud classifier on highly imbalanced transaction data (~0.17% fraud rate), significantly improving fraud recall compared to baseline models.  
- Implemented business-driven threshold tuning, achieving a balanced recall-precision ratio.  
- Attained high ROC-AUC scores (above 0.9) while prioritizing recall for fraud detection applications.  
- Integrated SHAP explainability to enhance feature-level transparency for both global trends and individual predictions.  
- Deployed a FastAPI inference service, containerized with Docker, incorporating automated CI checks and experiment tracking via MLflow.  

### RAG Chatbot (NLP / LLM Project)  
- **Technologies:** Python, FastAPI, Ollama, Sentence-transformers, ChromaDB  
- Developed a fully offline RAG system to answer queries grounded in PDFs and lecture videos.  
- Implemented hybrid retrieval using vector similarity (ChromaDB) and keyword-based scoring to enhance answer relevance.  
- Built an idempotent ingestion pipeline for PDF parsing, Whisper-based transcription, chunking, and embeddings.  
- Integrated local LLM inference (Ollama) with strict context enforcement to minimize hallucinations.  

## Professional Experience  
### Ciklum (Pixellot AI Sports Production)  
**Support Engineer**  
Mar 2024 – Present | Chennai  
- Supported a large-scale sports production platform utilized by globally distributed clients in a B2B environment.  
- Monitored system and stream health using Grafana dashboards, proactively identifying anomalies to prevent downstream failures.  
- Diagnosed pipeline failures, data inconsistencies, and configuration issues through application and system log analysis.  
- Conducted acceptance testing for new installations to ensure system stability prior to client handover.  
- Collaborated with R&D teams to escalate recurring and critical issues, contributing to long-term system reliability.  

### Infosys  
**System Engineer**  
Oct 2020 – Mar 2024 | Chennai  
- Resolved Windows OS and enterprise application incidents within SLA using ServiceNow.  
- Performed patching, vulnerability remediation, and system administration across servers and workstations.  
- Supported Office 365 services including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.  
- Contributed to operational improvements through proactive monitoring and issue prevention.  

## Certifications  
- AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01)  
- ITIL V4 Foundation – Service Management Best Practices  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)  
- Business Communication Excellence – Level 5  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)  

## Education  
**University of Madras**  
Bachelor of Computer Applications  
2017 – 2020 | Chennai, India  

**Dhanalakshmi School**  
Higher Secondary  
2017 | Chennai
